questions.title: 01 Read the angle interval
questions.objective: Interpret the endpoints of the permitted angle interval.
questions.prerequisites: Read inequalities and know that one turn is 2 pi radians.

questions.title: 02 Complete a sine solution set
questions.objective: Find the second permitted angle for the given sine value.
questions.prerequisites: Read exact radian angles and recognize unit-circle height.

questions.title: 03 Isolate the sine value
questions.objective: Choose the equivalent equation with sine isolated.
questions.prerequisites: Apply the same addition and nonzero division to both sides.

questions.title: 04 Explain the matching height
questions.objective: Choose the transformation that preserves the given sine value.
questions.prerequisites: Understand sine as height and reflection across the vertical axis.

questions.title: 05 Repair the first interval error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect line and repair the complete solution set.
questions.prerequisites: Read an integer parameter and apply both interval endpoints.

questions.title: 06 Solve a fresh sine equation
questions.objective: Choose all solutions in the stated interval.
questions.prerequisites: Use exact angles, sine signs and interval membership.
